answer: Each agent is one vertex in a stake-weighted trust graph: it posts a refundable bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. A fresh account sits in the shallow lagoon of near-zero weight, so a clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, and sybil cost scales linearly. Honest standing accrues slowly and is as hard to forge as a true violet dye: no cheap trick mints it in bulk.
